home.name: Angel L. Valdés
home.resume: Frontend-focused Full-Stack Developer passionate about UX/UI. I have been programming since 2016 and have nearly 3 years of professional experience building Angular, React and Spring Boot applications, including public transportation apps for the Basque Country (Spain). I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Software Engineering, researching how LLMs can automate requirements engineering, and I integrate AI into products where it adds real value. timeline.title: Master's Degree in Software Engineering
timeline.description: I am currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Software Engineering at the Technological University of the Mixteca (UTM) in Oaxaca, Mexico.

timeline.title: GENTALIA.SA
timeline.description: As a Full-Stack Developer, I built and maintained public transportation apps for the Basque Country (Spain) with Angular and Spring Boot: Lurraldebus, with real-time arrival times and route planning between municipalities, and LurTicket, for mobile ticket purchases on long-distance routes.

timeline.title: CUJAE University
timeline.description: As a Full-Stack Web Developer at the Directorate of ICT Services (DISERTIC) of the Technological University of Havana José Antonio Echeverría (CUJAE), I built custom websites with React and Spring Boot and trained new team members.

timeline.title: Computer Science Engineering Degree
timeline.description: I earned a degree in Computer Science Engineering (Ingeniero en Ciencias Informáticas) at the University of Informatics Sciences (UCI) in Havana, graduating with 4.74/5. The degree is revalidated in Mexico by the SEP.
